newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Matrix cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Matrix cut to hold.

text.p: -- CS First Boston said Friday it cut Matrix Pharmaceuticals Inc to hold from buy.
-- Analyst Jeff Swarz cited a Food and Drug Administration letter identifying issues to be resolved before the company's application for AccuSite Injectable Gel could be approved.
-- The most important point was concern that the follow-up period for AccuSite trials was not long enough. AccuSite is used to treat genital warts.
-- "This could delay entry of AccuSite six to nine months," Swarz said. "The stock isn't going anywhere."
